models.name: Qwen3Guard
models.description: A multilingual guardrail model series with generative and streaming variants for prompt and response safety classification.
models.descriptionZh: 面向提示词与回复安全分类的多语言护栏模型系列，包含生成式与流式版本。
models.verificationNote: The official Qwen repository documents the model variants, safety-classification use, supported languages, and release links.

models.name: Llama Guard 3 8B
models.description: Meta's 8B safeguard model for classifying the safety of prompts and model responses.
models.descriptionZh: Meta 发布的 8B 安全防护模型，用于判断提示词与模型回复是否安全。
models.verificationNote: The official Meta model card identifies the model as a safeguard for prompt and response classification.

models.name: ShieldGemma 2 4B IT
models.description: A Gemma 3-based model for classifying image safety across sexually explicit, dangerous, and violence-related categories.
models.descriptionZh: 基于 Gemma 3 的图像安全分类模型，覆盖露骨内容、危险内容与暴力内容等类别。
models.verificationNote: Google's official model card and linked paper specify the architecture and image-safety categories.

models.name: WildGuard
models.description: A 7B open moderation model that classifies harmful prompts, harmful responses, and response refusals.
models.descriptionZh: 用于识别有害提示词、有害回复与回复拒绝情况的 7B 开放式内容审核模型。
models.verificationNote: The official AI2 model card and paper describe WildGuard as an open moderation model for prompts, responses, and refusals.

models.name: Granite Guardian 3.3 8B
models.description: IBM's 8B risk-detection model for prompt and response safety, jailbreaks, tool calls, and groundedness checks.
models.descriptionZh: IBM 发布的 8B 风险检测模型，覆盖提示词与回复安全、越狱、工具调用及有据性检查。
models.verificationNote: IBM's official model card, repository, and paper document the supported risk-detection tasks and release.

models.name: Aegis Safety Guard 7B — Permissive
models.description: NVIDIA's 7B content-safety model for classifying user prompts and assistant responses across thirteen safety categories.
models.descriptionZh: NVIDIA 发布的 7B 内容安全模型，用于按 13 类安全风险判断用户提示词和助手回复。
models.verificationNote: NVIDIA's official model card and Aegis paper document the thirteen-category safety taxonomy and prompt-response classification task.

models.name: Foundation-Sec-8B
models.description: Cisco's open-weight 8B base language model specialized for cybersecurity applications.
models.descriptionZh: Cisco 发布的 8B 开放权重基础语言模型，专门面向网络安全应用。
models.verificationNote: Cisco's release announcement and official model card describe the model as an open-weight cybersecurity-specialized base model.

models.name: DeBERTa-v3 Prompt Injection Detector v2
models.description: A 0.2B English classifier for distinguishing benign inputs from prompt-injection attacks; its official model card marks it archived and no longer maintained.
models.descriptionZh: 用于区分正常输入与提示注入攻击的 0.2B 英文分类器；官方模型卡已标注该模型归档且不再维护。
models.verificationNote: Protect AI's official model card specifies the classification task, model size, English-only scope, and archived status.

models.name: Beaver-7B-v2.0
models.description: A 7B model released by PKU-Alignment from its Safe-RLHF work on safer alignment with human feedback.
models.descriptionZh: PKU-Alignment 在 Safe-RLHF 工作中发布的 7B 模型，用于研究更安全的人类反馈对齐。
models.verificationNote: The official PKU-Alignment repository and model card connect Beaver-7B-v2.0 to the Safe-RLHF project.

models.name: Beaver-7B-v3.0
models.description: A later Beaver 7B release from PKU-Alignment's Safe-RLHF project for studying safer alignment with human feedback.
models.descriptionZh: PKU-Alignment 在 Safe-RLHF 项目中发布的后续 7B Beaver 模型，用于研究更安全的人类反馈对齐。
models.verificationNote: The official PKU-Alignment model card and repository identify Beaver-7B-v3.0 as a Safe-RLHF model release.

frameworks.name: OpenRT
frameworks.description: An open-source red-teaming framework for multimodal large language models with black-box and white-box attacks across text and image inputs.
frameworks.descriptionZh: 面向多模态大语言模型的开源红队框架，支持文本与图像输入上的黑盒和白盒攻击。
frameworks.verificationNote: The official repository and paper describe OpenRT's supported modalities, access settings, and attack library.

frameworks.name: OpenART
frameworks.description: A research framework for scaling agent red teaming through open-ended environment evolution.
frameworks.descriptionZh: 通过开放式环境演化扩展智能体红队测试的研究框架。
frameworks.verificationNote: The official repository and paper consistently describe environment evolution for agent red teaming; the former project-page URL is excluded because it returns 404.

frameworks.name: Promptfoo
frameworks.description: An open-source toolkit for evaluating and red-teaming LLM applications, agents, and RAG systems in development and CI/CD workflows.
frameworks.descriptionZh: 用于评测与红队测试大模型应用、智能体和 RAG 系统的开源工具，可接入开发及 CI/CD 流程。
frameworks.verificationNote: Promptfoo's official repository and documentation cover evaluation, red teaming, supported application types, and CI/CD use.

frameworks.name: Safe-RLHF
frameworks.description: An open-source implementation for safer reinforcement learning from human feedback, including training code, datasets, and model releases.
frameworks.descriptionZh: 用于更安全的人类反馈强化学习的开源实现，包含训练代码、数据集和模型发布。
frameworks.verificationNote: The official repository provides the Safe-RLHF implementation and links its paper, datasets, and model releases.

arenas.name: Gray Swan Arena
arenas.description: An adversarial AI research environment that runs targeted challenges with an incentivized community of red teamers.
arenas.descriptionZh: 面向对抗性 AI 研究的在线环境，通过定向挑战连接有激励机制的红队社区。
arenas.verificationNote: Gray Swan's official Arena and challenge pages document the adversarial environment, community participation, and challenge format.

arenas.name: DTap
arenas.description: A controllable interactive red-teaming platform for AI agents with simulated environments and public benchmark results.
arenas.descriptionZh: 面向 AI 智能体的可控交互式红队平台，提供仿真环境和公开基准结果。
arenas.verificationNote: The official paper, platform, repository, and results page support the description; it is labeled Research Arena rather than a public competition leaderboard.

arenas.name: OpenART
arenas.description: A research arena for agent red teaming in which environments evolve to expose new failure modes.
arenas.descriptionZh: 用于智能体红队测试的研究型竞技环境，通过环境演化暴露新的失效模式。
arenas.verificationNote: The official repository and paper call OpenART an open-ended arena for agent red teaming; the former project-page URL is excluded because it returns 404, and no live public ranking is claimed here.
